title: the Crescent Cove Rising Revisited
author: Orsen Vasquez
blurb: Elodie Fairweather, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
